syllabus_note: Paper 6B is Section B of Intermediate Paper 6 (Financial Management and Strategic Management) and carries 50 marks. 'syllabus_items' per chapter is ICAI's verbatim SYLLABUS wording; 'topics' expands that using ICAI's own DETAILED CONTENTS headings plus section headings verified inside the chapter PDFs. Study material edition: July 2024, reprint August 2025, 'Relevant for May, 2026 Examination'. The same 5 chapters appear unchanged in all 8 new-scheme RTPs from May 2024 through September 2026, so the structure is stable.

Importance and Limitations of Strategic Management
Strategic Intent - Vision, Mission and Goals & Values
